notes: Needs ruling (rule 11, first-person narrative with implicit transmission): from «قال دخلنا على جابر» the story is told in the first person of the father, who names himself inside it («فقلت أنا محمد بن علي بن حسين»); the self-naming is not used to complete «أبيه», which stays a relation link
«الدمشقيان» is a dual nisba shared by Hisham and Sulayman, so the surface stops before it; «- وربما زاد بعضهم ... -» is an editor's gloss
«قال عثمان» and «قال ابن نفيل» inside the saying are wording differences and are left out
